summary.title: Pui Ching Middle School in Macao Unveils Its “Smart Education Center,” Showcasing ZMROBO’s Global Model Classroom!

newsInfo.title: Pui Ching Middle School in Macao Unveils Its “Smart Education Center,” Showcasing ZMROBO’s Global Model Classroom!
newsInfo.content:
On September 14, 2026, the Smart Education Center at Pui Ching Middle School in Macao was officially completed and opened, marking a new stage in the school’s development of AI education, robotics education, and innovative talent development.

 

Jointly established by Pui Ching Middle School in Macao and ZMROBO, the center is a leading AI innovation classroom in the Greater Bay Area, combining model teaching and teacher training.

 

At the opening ceremony, ZMROBO and Shengtong Institute of Education awarded Pui Ching Middle School plaques recognizing it as an “AI Teaching and Training Base” and an “AI Model Classroom.” The Smart Education Hub in the Greater Bay Area and ZMROBO’s Global Model Classroom were officially launched, providing a reference model for AI education worldwide.

 


Pui Ching Middle School in Macao is a representative leading school in the Greater Bay Area. With a long history of education, the school has long been committed to rigorous academic standards and a forward-looking educational vision, nurturing generations of outstanding students with a global perspective. Its graduates pursue further studies across Mainland China, Macao and Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia, and other regions, with many gaining admission to highly ranked universities worldwide.

 

The completion of the Smart Education Center extends the school’s strengths into the field of technology talent development. The comprehensive skills students develop through AI project-based practice and competitions, together with their project achievements and competition experience, can also provide more compelling evidence of their capabilities when applying to top universities, particularly in fields such as AI, engineering, and computer science.



Address by Kou Kam Fai, Principal of Pui Ching Middle School

 

 


Address by Zou Baoming,Vice President of Shengtong Education Group & General Manager of ZMROBO

 

The Smart Education Center is organized into four core areas: a teaching area, a training area, a project exhibition area, and an equipment storage area, creating an intelligent educational environment that connects teaching, practice, exhibition, and management. Powered by the ZMROBO Integrated AI Education Solution, the center has established a three-in-one intelligent education system integrating courses, co-curricular activities, and competitions.

 

 

The curriculum covers robotics structures, drive systems, sensor applications, programming, control logic, and AI concepts. Through project-based learning, students build a learning pathway from foundational understanding of AI and skills training to project creation and achievement showcase. Co-curricular activities extend into areas such as smart mobile robots, 3D design, circuit design, and competition training, enabling students to deepen their expertise, build team cohesion, and broaden their horizons through inter-school exchanges.


 

 

In technology competitions, the center adopts the Super AI Challenge competition system, with students participating in themed events such as “Star Cruise,” “Star Showdown,” and “SmartCraft Challenge.” Through preparation, competition, and exchange, students develop skills in AI project strategy, real-time decision-making, problem analysis, communication, and collaboration. They also progress from the school campus to the national and even global stage for technology-based practice, truly promoting learning, creativity, and growth through competition.

 

Going forward, ZMROBO will continue working with Pui Ching Middle School to advance the application of AI education in a globally exemplary classroom, rooted in the Greater Bay Area and reaching a global audience, while showcasing the “Pui Ching approach” to AI education. Together, we will nurture future talent equipped with technological literacy, creative thinking, teamwork, and the ability to learn continuously.

newsInfo.title: 2021 WORLD ROBOT CONFERENCE, ZMROBO Super Track Competition and Smart Warehouse Competition light up AI "Super Match"!
newsInfo.author: LZS
newsInfo.content:
From September 10 to 13, "2021 WORLD ROBOT CONFERENCE" was grandly held in Beijing, China, with 2000 players competing PK on the same stage. The competition also includes trials and finals, and the annual number of participants is expected to exceed 40000. ZMROBO cooperates in the operation of Super Track Competition and Smart Warehouse Competition.

 

 

    The WORLD ROBOT CONFERENCE is the world's top competition in the field. You can watch the wonderful competition in 3 categories, 4 events, 41 events and 98 competition groups at the competition site. Among them, nearly 100 players participated in the Super Track Competition and the Smart Warehouse Competition respectively.

 

 

    The theme of this ZMROBO Super Track Competition is "Interstellar Exploration", and the groups are divided into primary school group, junior middle school group and senior high school group. At the same time, robots of ZMROBO are the official designated equipment of the Super Track Competition. The competition of Smart Warehouse project focuses on the application and thinking of real science and technology industry. The Warehouse Design Competition requires middle and higher vocational students to make comprehensive use of software and hardware design, task programming and image recognition.

 


 

    ZMROBO Super Track is one of most popular competition, more and more children participate in. 

    ZMROBO creates a smart age with students!

newsInfo.title: Promoting teachers` professional development through training --2021 ZMROBO event engineer certification training course [phase I]
newsInfo.author: LZS
newsInfo.content:
Guided by China Youth Science and technology counselors Association, sponsored by Shengtong Education Research Institute, and undertaken by ZMROBO, the 2021 ZMROBO event engineer certification training class [phase I] was held in Shanghai from July 9 to 11, 2021. A large number of excellent teachers from schools / educational institutions from all over the country gathered here to concentrate on their skills. Start a new journey!

 

 

    ZMROBO event engineer certification training course is held in four phases (2021.07-2022.01). The purpose of the activity is to improve the special teaching level and ability of youth education counselors and coaches, promote the professional growth of teachers, connect with and lead the innovation and development of science and technology education. The first phase of training activities is mainly around the super track race [WRC] event.

 

 

 

    As the official cooperation event of WRC world robot competition for many years, each session of ZMROBO super track competition attracts many teams from all over the world to participate with its unique interest, challenge and innovation. Over the years, the competition heat has continued to rise, and the overall competition scale has increased by more than 30% every year. It is known as the evergreen tree of robot competition.

 

 

 

 

    In addition, ZMROBO super track race, as a local event brand in China, has been widely recognized by the youth science and technology center of China Association for science and technology, China Electronics Society and education and science and technology departments at all levels in China. The competition has entered into the National Students' information literacy promotion practice activities of the central audio visual education Museum, and the "world robot competition" of China Electronics Society.

 

 

Teachers visit Shengtong Education Center

 

 

 

Teachers visit ZMROBO exhibition experience base

 

    In order to better promote the robot race to the public and popularize robot knowledge and education, ZMROBO super track race adopts the global selection system. There are three stages of competition (primary school, junior high school and senior high school), covering students aged 6-18. From entry to advanced stage, there are corresponding stages to participate in.

 

    In terms of event equipment, building blocks and rich accessories are equipped with complete and easy to understand construction manual and course materials. Students can give full play to imagination and realize smooth construction. Meanwhile, with the cooperation of software, simple graphical programming software is used to reduce the threshold of programming technology for competitors, so that the players can smoothly transition from graphic programming to code programming learning. It is of great significance to improve the global level of comprehensive professional level of intelligent robot cognition and application and to stimulate the cultivation of the innovative consciousness of young students.

 

 

 

 

Teacher award ceremony

 

    Through these days of study, teachers have gained a lot, their professional ability has been significantly improved, and their ability and confidence to do a good job in professional work under the new situation have been enhanced. Several leaders of ZMROBO awarded the training certificate of youth counselors Association of China Association for science and technology, the certificate of ZMROBO technology and the official certification plaque of the training base.

 

 

 

    Closely following the idea of Ideological Education in the new era, and earnestly implementing the theme education, ZMROBO has been steadily promoting the construction of the teaching team of youth education robot for many years, comprehensively improving the level and quality of teachers' special technology teaching, so as to promote the teaching, and provide strong support for the professional, orderly and large-scale development of youth robot education.

newsInfo.title: Strategic development cooperation of ZMROBO and SenseTime, new artificial intelligence (AI) has wonderful appearance!
newsInfo.author: LZS
newsInfo.content:
On July 9, Shengtong education· ZMROBO and SenseTime Education officially announced strategic cooperation at the Shanghai "Boundless love · symbiosis" theme artificial intelligence industry forum!

 

 

    "Boundless love, symbiosis" - The AI Enterprise Forum with the theme of "Boundless love · symbiosis" focused on the most forward-looking views and propositions in the field of AI. Liu Cixin, Nobel laureate Michael Levitt, Xue Lan and other industry celebrities gathered to conduct in-depth exchanges and discussions on the latest development of AI technology and industrial landing, AI innovation imagination, etc. So as to promote cross-border cooperation and application of AI, It's a world-class feast for AI. 

 

Signing ceremony

 

    Jia Chunlin, President of Shengtong education and chairman of ZMROBO, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Gao Yan, general manager of SenseTime education.

    The signing of this agreement marks the official launch of the cooperation between our company and SenseTime education on artificial intelligence technology and business. The two sides will work together to build a new ecosystem of intelligent education, and further promote the innovation of application products and popularization of artificial intelligence education for teenagers.

 

 

 

 

 

ZMROBO and early stage of SenseTime Education

  

    In the early stage of the signing of the agreement, ZMROBO and SenseTime education exchanged visits for many times, discussed cooperation in technology, business and other aspects, reached the intention of deep cooperation in artificial intelligence education, and jointly launched the "Shang Xiaoming" series of artificial intelligence products.

 

"Shang Xiaoming"   Official appearance!

 

    Over the years, ZMROBO has always been deeply involved in the popularization and application of educational robots, and its self-developed products have been widely used in the education industry. Our company adheres to scientific and technological innovation as the basis, and constantly strengthens the technical reserves and R & D strength: we have more than 900 patents, and independently research and develop up to 60 + products. ZMROBO Virtual Simulation online experience platform integrates a variety of mainstream programming languages such as graphical programming, scratch and python, and covers many use scenarios such as offline and online PC end and mobile end.

 

 

 

    As a subsidiary of Shengtong Education (Stock Code: 002599), ZMROBO will continue to give full play to its brand and technical advantages in the future development, focus on product and content innovation, and promote the cultivation of young people's artificial intelligence talents.

    Zhou Wei, vice president of Shengtong education, Zou Baoming, general manager of ZMROBO and Chen Wei, vice general manager of ZMROBO attended the signing ceremony.

Authorized by China Association of Children's Science Instructors http://www.cacsi.org.cn/  , Joinmax Digital Technology Ltd held a robot training session named JOINMAX EDUCATIONAL ROBOT in Rosedale Hotel Guangzhou, August 8-13. Over 150 teachers attended the session. 

 

    There were 32 periods, including the usage and curriculum of major STEAM sets (Science Storm, WiseKit, WiseChild, WiseBuy), and corresponding competitions.

 

    Amazed by the product functions and courses, the teachers made the best of every minute in raising questions with instructors and sharing opinions and experience  with each other.
